event: According to reporting by Gizmodo and a Reuters investigation published November 3, OpenAI employees had reportedly warned for years about weaknesses in the company's internal security practices, and Anthropic reportedly disputed how Cathedral Systems — a firm whose researchers previously tested Anthropic's systems — had conducted that test, saying its most sensitive systems were unaffected. OpenAI announced the Cathedral partnership days after the Hugging Face incident disclosures. (OpenAI, 2026-11-04.)
